title: Necromancer's Ritual
description: A multi-armed skeletal necromancer stands atop a dark mound of earth and coins, holding an open spellbook, bones, and ritual items. Swirling particles, golden rings, shadowy figures, and floating orbs surround the figure against a smoky, ethereal background.
prompt: A skeletal necromancer with multiple arms wearing a hooded robe covered in symbols, standing on a mound of dark earth and scattered gold coins. The figure holds an open spellbook with runes, several large bones, and a ritual dagger. Swirling black particles and golden magical rings float around the scene, with shadowy silhouetted figures in the background and a glowing halo of circles behind the skull head.
